# Scriptable.dev

Free versioned web components for Israeli websites. Single script tag — no npm, no build step.
Served from Vercel's global CDN. All versioned URLs are permanently immutable.

## Components

### coordinator@1.0.0
Prevents floating widget overlap. Must load **before** all other components.

```html
<script src="https://scriptable.dev/coordinator@1.0.0.js"></script>
```

### accessibility@1.0.0
Accessibility panel — font size, contrast, grayscale, RTL. Hebrew UI.

```html
<script src="https://scriptable.dev/accessibility@1.0.0.js"></script>
```

### whatsapp@1.0.0
Floating WhatsApp button.

```html
<script src="https://scriptable.dev/whatsapp@1.0.0.js"
  data-phone="972501234567"
  data-message="היי, אשמח לשמוע פרטים"></script>
```

### navigate@1.0.0
Floating navigation button — opens Google Maps and/or Waze.

```html
<script src="https://scriptable.dev/navigate@1.0.0.js"
  data-address="רחוב הרצל 1, תל אביב"></script>
```

### share@1.0.0
Share buttons for WhatsApp, Facebook, Telegram, X, LinkedIn and more.

```html
<script src="https://scriptable.dev/share@1.0.0.js"
  data-networks="whatsapp,facebook,telegram"></script>
```

## Standard parameters — all floating components

Every floating component supports these parameters:

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------------|
| `data-size` | number | `56` | Button diameter in px |
| `data-color` | hex string | component default | Main button background color |
| `data-no-coordinator` | attribute (no value) | — | Bypass coordinator — use component's own fixed position |

Coordinator also accepts `data-size` as a **global default** for all registered buttons.
Individual `data-size` on a component overrides the coordinator's global.

## Component parameters

### coordinator
| Parameter | Default | Description |
|-----------|---------|-------------|
| `data-size` | `56` | Global button size for all managed components |

### whatsapp
| Parameter | Default | Description |
|-----------|---------|-------------|
| `data-phone` | **required** | Phone number (digits or E.164 format) |
| `data-message` | — | Pre-filled WhatsApp message |
| `data-label` | `'שלחו לנו הודעה'` | Hover tooltip text |
| `data-tooltip` | `'true'` | Set `"false"` to hide hover tooltip |
| `data-color` | `'#25D366'` | Button background color |
| `data-target` | — | CSS selector — render inline inside element |

### navigate
| Parameter | Default | Description |
|-----------|---------|-------------|
| `data-address` | required* | Street address |
| `data-lat` / `data-lng` | required* | Coordinates (alternative to address) |
| `data-apps` | `'google,waze'` | Apps to show: `google`, `waze` |
| `data-label` | `'נווט אלינו'` | Button aria-label |
| `data-color` | `'#4285F4'` | Button background color |
| `data-target` | — | CSS selector — render inline |

### accessibility
| Parameter | Default | Description |
|-----------|---------|-------------|
| `data-color` | `'#1a1a1a'` | Toggle button color |

### share
| Parameter | Default | Description |
|-----------|---------|-------------|
| `data-networks` | `'whatsapp,facebook,telegram,twitter'` | Comma-separated networks |
| `data-text` | `document.title` | Share text |
| `data-url` | `window.location.href` | URL to share |
| `data-layout` | `'horizontal'` | Inline layout: `horizontal` or `vertical` |
| `data-direction` | `'up'` | Floating panel direction: `up` or `left` |
| `data-color` | `'#1a1a1a'` | Toggle button color |
| `data-target` | — | CSS selector — render inline |

## Typical multi-widget setup

```html
<!-- coordinator first — sets global size 48px -->
<script src="https://scriptable.dev/coordinator@1.0.0.js" data-size="48"></script>

<!-- managed — stacked automatically, inherit size 48 -->
<script src="https://scriptable.dev/whatsapp@1.0.0.js"
  data-phone="972501234567"
  data-color="#FF6B00"></script>
<script src="https://scriptable.dev/accessibility@1.0.0.js"></script>

<!-- independent — not managed by coordinator, own position -->
<script src="https://scriptable.dev/navigate@1.0.0.js"
  data-address="רחוב הרצל 1, תל אביב"
  data-no-coordinator></script>
```

## Versioning

- Versions are immutable — pinned URLs never change behavior
- Format: `component@MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH`
- MAJOR = breaking change | MINOR = new feature | PATCH = bug fix
